title: Page 3
content_zh:
于季友摇头。“很抱歉，就这事不能依公主。”
这家伙！普宁大叫：“来人呐，拿下他。”
一个是公主一个是将来的驸马，站在门房四周的护卫面面相觑，不知该做何反应。
“你们造反啦？”普宁惊讶。“你们不知道我是谁？我要你们拿下他，你们竟敢不听！”
“他们当然不会听。”于季友边说，边从怀里掏出令牌。“瞧瞧这是什么－－”
御赐金牌，犹如皇上亲临。
这方令牌，是皇上担心途中发生危险，特让于季友带在身边，好调度周边镇甸差吏用的。他大概也没想到，这方令牌头一个治的，会是自个儿的掌上明珠。
在场所有人一见，同时屈膝跪下。“吾皇万岁万万岁。”
“儿臣叩见父王。”普宁银牙一咬，不得不屈身拜见。
“都起来吧。”于季友将令牌收回，然后眼一瞟，要伺候公主的女官们向前。“带公主回房休息。”
普宁甩去女官们的搀扶。“不用，我自个儿会走。”她气闷地走了两步，又突然回头，气忿地吼道：“于季友－－你给我记好了，你今天的所做所为，总有一天，我会要你付出代价！”
说完，她重踩着脚步离开。
一整晚，普宁怨气难消，不管女官们送来什么吃食，再怎么苦劝，她一概不吃。
气都气饱了还吃什么！她想。
“公主，再没胃口也得多少吃点，万一饿坏了身子……”
“怎么样？”她板起脸。“怕我有个万一我父王会唯你们是问？原来本公主吃饭不是因为我自己高兴喜欢，是为了保有你们头上这几颗脑袋？”
“不是的公主，小的们是真的担心您的身体……”
普宁驳斥道：“我才不相信你们是真的关心我，早先我要你们帮我松绑，要你们想办法把于季友找来，你们做了什么？”
“公主……”女官们满脸疚色。
“少在那找借口，我才不相信你们。”普宁一抹眼眶。

说到底，她的娇蛮、逞强、任性，不过是种伪装。她在宫里十七年，见过太多嘴脸，更知道不是所有人，都是打自内心喜欢她、接受她。
她恐惧让人发现，她怕寂寞、怕人不理她、不在乎她。
所以她不给人选择的机会，直接下达命令，要所有人全按她指示行事。这样一来，她就永远不会知道有人不喜欢她，但相对的，当她发现连命令都无法使人听命的时候，她便手足无措了。
她很寂寞。但是这一点寂寞，她又没办法向其他人吐露。
要她说什么？高处不胜寒很苦？受太多人的期待重视，只会让人倍觉沉重？
这些话语，只会教人更觉得她身在福中不知福。
她很清楚，高高在上受人拥戴的公主，不应、也没资格抱怨寂寞。
“你们走，全都给我出去，我看到你们就烦。”普宁连抓带轰将女官们推出她房间，门一关上，她在里边推桌踢椅，闹了个天翻地覆，才扑上雕花大床，埋头痛哭。
候在门外的女官们一直等到哭声隐去，才胆敢推门观望－－房里乱成一团。
普宁呢，应该是哭累了，绣鞋也没脱，趴在床上睡着了。
几人看着床上如花似玉的脸蛋，又是摇头又是叹息。她们这个公主啊，心情好的时候，笑靥如花，出手更是大方不吝啬，只可惜太孩子心性，一闹起脾气，说风是雨。
但就算她不好伺候，宫里却没人不喜欢她。她有股奇妙的魅力，只要看过她，就忘不了她甜甜的笑脸，让人发自内心想替她效命－－就像宫苑里带刺的蔷薇，照顾起来费心费时，但一当盛放，又立刻让人忘了先前的辛劳。
只希望将来的驸马爷能看清楚公主的伪装，知道她刁蛮的外表下，不过是个没心机的孩子。
女官们合力将桌椅搬回原位，撤下菜肴；又帮普宁脱去鞋袜，卸去她满头的珠花翠饰。
蹑手蹑脚，女官们拉来棉被帮她盖上，吹熄烛火，将房门关起。
第2章(1)
翌日，天色刚露鱼肚白，迎娶队伍已经在路上。
昨晚普宁大闹行馆的事，于季友都知道；而今由普宁没用膳的事，女官也来通知他了。女官问他怎么办才好，没想到他的答案竟是－－
“等她饿了，她自然会吃。”
也就是说，普宁吃不吃饭，他一点都不在意。

女官还以为于季友会怜惜，会愿意跟她过去说两句好听话，没想到得到这种答案，只好黯然离去。
趁帮主子穿衣的时候，里小声问：“公主不吃饭，大人真的不担心？”
“我担心有用么？”于季友反问。
“说得也对－－”胡里欲语还休。“好啦，小的就直说了，小的是觉得，大人多少该盥去一点关心……”
“不要。”于季友毫不妥协，打从见到普宁，他就对她有成见，打定主意认为两人不适合。更何况昨天的事他根本没错，凭什么要他主动示好？
糟了糟了，他就担心会这样。肙里叹气，两个人脾气都倔，谁也不服谁，结果就是这样，强成了一团。
不过话说回来，昨天的冲突也不能全怪公主，他家主子也有错；人家好歹是公主，他把人当马似地栓在轿子里，任谁都会生气。
只是这种话，胡里还找不到机会说，他也怕主子生他气。
正午，于季友下令停轿歇息，随行的厨子就地熬了一锅全羊汤，添上硬发的面饼，就成了羊肉泡膜。
女官端来一碗。“公主，刚煮好的羊肉泡膜，您试试，闻起来香极了。”
但普宁一瞧碗里褐褐白白单调的配色，摇了摇头，连口汤也不愿意喝。
“但您已经连着两顿没吃……”
“要我吃也行，只要把那家伙找来。”
“这个……”女官们面面相觑。
“办不到就退下去。”普宁撤下厚帘，再不肯开口说话。
女官们没辙，只能再向于季友求援。
没想到他仍是老话一句：“我说过成亲之前，绝不与她见面。”
怎么办？端着热气腾腾的羊肉泡膜，女官们进退失据，不知如何是好。
稍后，大队开拔，正式迈入前后不着村店的深林野地。于季反派胡里过来提醒，说接连几天，大队得在野地扎营，一干女眷绝不可落单行进，以免发生危险。
女官们表示知道。

胡里一看彩轿，小声探问：“今天公主很安静啊？”
一女官瞪眼。“要你饿了三顿没吃，还能活蹦乱跳？”
胡里一惊。“哎呦！那水呢？总有喝水吧？”
“喝了。”女官一脸愁。“但光喝水也不是办法，我们几个正在想，该用什么法子诱公主吃点东西，我们真担心她。”
胡里把消息带回于季友那。
“大人，小的劝您，还是别再跟公主斗气了。”
于季友皱眉。“你觉得是我不对？”
“小的不是这意思。”胡里很清楚这时候绝对不能扯上“对，错”两字。“小的是担心公主身子。您想想，她一个千金娇公主，从小到大没捱过一点苦，突然来个三顿没吃，别说下月初一，怕过不了两天，公主先病倒了。”
“那个刁蛮公主到底有什么魅力？值得你这么替她说话？”普宁会不会生病，于季友压根儿不在乎，但他从胡里眸里看出，他这随从似乎已经倒戈站到她身边去了。
“公主很漂亮啊，像朵花似的，让她成天开开心心有什么不好……”胡里嘟嚷着。
见色忘义！于季友鼻一哼。“说来说去，你就是希望我去劝她？”
content_en:
Yu Jiyou shook his head. "I'm sorry, but I can't obey Princess on this matter."
This guy! Puning shouted: "Here comes someone, take him down."
One was the princess and the other was the future consort. The guards standing around the gatehouse looked at each other, not knowing how to react.
"Are you rebelling?" Puning was surprised. "You don't know who I am? I asked you to take him down, but how dare you not listen!"
"Of course they won't listen." Yu Jiyou said, taking out the token from his arms. "Look what this is—"
The gold medal given by the emperor is like the emperor's personal presence.
The emperor was worried about danger on the way, so he asked Yu Jiyou to take this token with him so that he could use it to dispatch officials in surrounding towns. He probably didn't expect that the first person to be cured by Fang Token would be the apple of his eye.
When everyone present saw him, they knelt down at the same time. "Long live my emperor."
"My dear father, I bow to you." Puning gritted his silver teeth and had no choice but to bow down and pay homage.
"Everyone, get up." Yu Jiyou took back the token, then glanced at the female officials who were about to serve the princess and moved forward. "Take the princess back to her room to rest."
Puning threw away the support of the female officials. "No, I can walk by myself." She took two steps angrily, then suddenly turned back and yelled angrily: "Yu Jiyou - please remember it for me. One day, I will make you pay for what you did today!"
After saying that, she stomped away.
All night long, Puning could not get rid of her resentment. No matter what food the female officials brought her, no matter how hard they tried to persuade her, she would not eat it.
What else can I eat when I’m so angry? she thought.
"Princess, even if you have no appetite, you have to eat as much as you can, in case you get starved..."
"How is it?" She asked with a straight face. "Afraid that if I have a problem, my father will only ask you questions? It turns out that this princess eats not because I like it, but because I want to keep these heads on your heads?"
"No princess, we are really worried about your health..."
Puning retorted: "I don't believe you really care about me. Earlier I asked you to help me loosen my ties and find a way to find Yu Jiyou. What did you do?"
"Princess..." The female officials looked guilty.
"Stop making excuses, I don't believe you." Puning rolled his eyes.
In the final analysis, her coquettishness, bravery, and willfulness are just a disguise. She has been in the palace for seventeen years and has seen too many faces. She also knows that not everyone likes and accepts her from the bottom of their hearts.
She is afraid of being discovered, of being lonely, of being ignored or not caring about her.
So she didn't give people a chance to choose, and directly issued orders, asking everyone to act according to her instructions. In this way, she would never know that someone didn't like her, but on the contrary, when she found that she couldn't even make people obey orders, she was at a loss.
She is lonely. But she couldn't express this loneliness to anyone else.
What do you want her to say? Is it bitter to be in the cold at high places? Being expected and valued by too many people will only make people feel heavier?
These words will only make people feel that she is not blessed despite being blessed.
She knew very well that a princess who was high and supported by others should not and had no right to complain about loneliness.
"You go, all get out of here. I get annoyed when I see you." Puning grabbed and blasted the female officials out of her room. As soon as the door was closed, she pushed the table and kicked the chairs inside. After making a huge fuss, she threw herself on the big carved bed and buried her head in tears.
The female officials waiting outside the door waited until the crying subsided before they dared to open the door and wait and see - the room was in chaos.
As for Puning, she must have been tired from crying. She didn't take off her embroidered shoes, so she fell asleep on the bed.
Several people looked at the beautiful faces on the bed, shaking their heads and sighing. They, princesses, smile like flowers when they are in a good mood, and are generous and generous with their actions. Unfortunately, they are too childish, and when they lose their temper, they say wind is rain.
But even if she is difficult to serve, no one in the palace dislikes her. She has a wonderful charm, as long as you have seen her, you will never forget her sweet smile, which makes people want to serve her from the bottom of their hearts - just like the thorny rose in the palace garden, it takes time and effort to take care of, but once it blooms, people immediately forget the previous hard work.
I only hope that the future prince-in-law can clearly see through the princess's disguise and know that beneath her unruly appearance, she is just a child without any intentions.
The female officials worked together to move the tables and chairs back to their original positions and remove the dishes; they also helped Puning take off her shoes and socks, and removed her head full of pearls and jade ornaments.
Quietly, the female officials pulled the quilt to cover her, blew out the candles, and closed the door.
Chapter 2(1)
The next day, the sky was just turning white, and the wedding procession was already on the way.
Yu Jiyou knew that Puning caused a scene in the hotel last night; now that Puning didn't have a meal, the female official also came to inform him. The female officer asked him what he should do, but to his surprise, his answer was -
"When she's hungry, she'll eat naturally."
In other words, he didn't care at all whether Puning ate or not.
The female officer thought that Yu Jiyou would take pity on her and would be willing to say a few nice words to her, but she didn't expect to get such an answer and had to leave sadly.
While helping the master get dressed, Li asked in a low voice: "The princess doesn't want to eat, are you really not worried?"
"Is it useful to worry?" Yu Jiyou asked.
"That's right -" Hu Li stopped talking. "Okay, I'll just tell you the truth. I think adults should pay more attention..."
"No." Yu Jiyou was uncompromising. From the moment he met Puning, he had a prejudice against her and made up his mind that the two of them were not suitable. What's more, he was absolutely right about what happened yesterday, so why should he take the initiative to show kindness?
Oh no, no, no, that's what he was worried about. Xie Li sighed, both of them had stubborn tempers and refused to obey the other. The result was like this, they became a bunch of enemies.
But having said that, yesterday's conflict cannot be entirely blamed on the princess. His master is also at fault; she is a princess after all, and he ties people up in a sedan chair like horses, which will make anyone angry.
It's just that Hu Li hasn't found a chance to say this yet. He's also afraid that his master will be angry with him.
At noon, Yu Jiyou ordered the sedan to stop for a rest, and the accompanying cook cooked a pot of whole lamb soup on the spot, added stiff noodles, and turned into mutton bubble wrap.
The female officer brought a bowl. "Princess, try the freshly cooked mutton soaked in membrane. It smells delicious."
But Puning looked at the monotonous color scheme of brown, brown, white and white in the bowl and shook his head, unwilling to even drink the soup.
"But you haven't eaten two meals in a row..."
"You can eat it if you want, as long as you find that guy."
"This..." The female officials looked at each other.
"If you can't do it, retreat." Puning pulled back the thick curtain and refused to speak again.
The female officials had no choice but to ask Yu Jiyou for help.
Unexpectedly, he still kept his old saying: "I said I would never meet her before we get married."
What to do? Holding the steaming mutton wrappers, the female officers were at a loss as to what to do.
Later, the brigade set off and officially entered the deep forest and wilderness with no villages or shops. Yu Ji's villain Hu Li came over to remind him that the brigade would have to camp in the wild for several days and the female family members must not travel alone to avoid danger.
The female officers said they knew.
Hu Li looked at the colorful sedan and asked in a low voice: "Is the princess very quiet today?"
A female officer stared. "How can you still be alive and kicking after being hungry for three meals without eating?"
Hu Li was shocked. "Ouch! What about water? You have to drink water, right?"
"Drink." The female officer looked worried. "But just drinking water is not the answer. We are thinking about how to lure the princess to eat something. We are really worried about her."
Hu Li brought the news back to Yu Ji Youna.
"Sir, I would like to advise you not to fight with the princess anymore."
Yu Jiyou frowned. "You think it's my fault?"
"That's not what I meant, little one." Hu Li knew very well that the words "right and wrong" must not be mentioned at this time. "The little one is worried about the princess' health. Think about it, sheA rich and charming princess, who had never experienced any hardship since she was a child, suddenly went without food for three times. Not to mention the first day of the next lunar month, she was afraid that within two days, the princess would fall ill first. "
"What is the charm of that unruly princess? Is it worthy for you to speak for her like this? "Yu Jiyou didn't care at all whether Puning would be sick, but he could see from Hu Li's eyes that his follower seemed to have switched sides and stood by her side.
"The princess is very beautiful, like a flower. What's wrong with making her happy all day long..." Hu Li muttered.
Seeing lust and forgetting one's righteousness! Yu Jiyou snorted. "After all, you just want me to persuade her? "
